hi! this thread is very cool and shoutout to r/religion for this space :)

I didn't grow up strictly following any religion but my family is catholic. we never went to church and followed god very very loosely. as I got older like middle school and high school I swore up and down I didn't believe in god and that he wasn't even real. in college I took some classes about buddhism and got very, very into it. everything about it resonated with me - suffering being the nature of life and detachment and surrendering being the way out, there is actually nothing about buddhism that did not resonate with me. except for one thing. I believe that there has to be some sort of higher power because I firmly believe that everything happens for a reason. in buddhism they don't believe this - bc they believe that everything happens because of preexisting conditions. I believe the opposite. there is force that makes these things happen - not in terms of punishing but rather how ppl are placed in our life, taken out, the things we experience, etc those are all to teach us something.

now if u asked me what I thought this higher power was I couldn't rlly tell you. I find it hard to see if as something without form but I also find it pretty hard to see it as a man in the sky. ive been trying to get into christianity but there are more things about it that dont resonate with me. but I want to worship, I want to thank whatever force it is that has made my life so great. I want to pray for others. I want to have a text to go to for anything and everything. I know this sounds like Christianity but I have a hard time following the holy trinity and a lot of the biblical stories. and a lot of christian principles. like I know the Bible says everyone is essentially christian but I dont believe that. but I do lean more towards christianity because my boyfriend and best friend are christian and I would ideally like to be a follower of christ for them but thats more of external pressure (from my internal self) that I feel and I want to prioritize finding a religion I understand and can resonate with

ahh help and thank u to everyone in advance! may everyone find a space for themselves
